notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast a spell using Kess's ability this turn.
You have not copied a spell using The Twelfth Doctor this turn.
description:
Cast Glorious End from your graveyard by paying {2}{R}, causing it to gain demonstrate due to The Twelfth Doctor.
Glorious End's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Glorious End, ending the turn, thus exiling all other spells and abilities on the stack.
The opponent will then lose the game during their next end step due to Glorious End's triggered ability.
